questions: What is passing?
If passing is denied, does that mean someone failed?
What is privilege?
If privilege is revoked, does access disappear?
What is labor?
When labor ends, is the work finished?
What is performance?
When a performance ends, does the role disappear?
What is visibility?
If visibility increases, does that make everyone safer?
What is identity?
If an identity is verified, is it settled?
What is orientation?
If orientation is unclear, can you still choose a direction?
What is care?
If care is outsourced, is the responsibility gone?
What is objectification?
If objectification makes interaction easier, is that a good result?
What is a code?
If the code is broken, does it stop working?
What is a transition?
Once a transition is complete, is the old identity gone?
What is consent?
If consent is given at the beginning, does it still hold later?
What is bias?
If bias is removed, will the result be neutral?
What is voice?
If a voice is heard clearly, has it been given power?
What is empowerment?
If empowerment is offered, does that mean power has been redistributed?
